related: blood pressure regulation during acute phase response
regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure during acute phase response

definition: Any process that modulates the force with which blood travels through the circulatory system that contributes to the acute phase response. The acute phase response occurs during the early phases of an infection and is marked by changes in the production of plasma proteins such as C-reactive protein.
label: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure involved in acute-phase response
